messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to hand off the Payments-v3 threat model + access review to eng + privacy before the compliance audit. Can we lock a 60m slot this week?

maya: Proposed agenda:
1) Scope & assets (what's in/out)
2) Data flow & trust boundaries (diagram walkthrough)
3) Current controls & gaps (ACLs, token usage, logs)
4) Action items, owners, timelines
5) Audit evidence checklist (who owns what)

maya: Pre-reads: https://redwood.internal/docs/payments-v3/arch-diagram (diagram) and the current ACL export in the repo. Please skim before the call.

tom: I can do Tue 3pm or Thu 10am PST. Tue would be better for me.

sara: Thu 10am PST works for me but I can make Tue if needed. Who from infra/ops should we pull in?

eli: Add me — I want to cover runtime telemetry and KV cache access patterns. Also want to confirm whether keys are rotated automations are running.

jen_privacy: I can join Tue 3pm for privacy signoff items. We should include a short section on data retention + DPIA touchpoints.

maya: Good — sounds like Tue 3pm PST is consensus. calendar-bot: Would you schedule a 60m meeting for Tue at 15:00 PST and invite maya, tom, sara, eli, jen_privacy, infra-oncall?

calendar-bot: Scheduled: Payments-v3 PrivSec Handoff — Tue 15:00 PST, 60m. Meeting link + POC in invite.

tom: Adding these pre-reads to the invite:
```
- arch-diagram: https://redwood.internal/docs/payments-v3/arch-diagram
- acl-export: repo://infra/payments-v3/acls/acl-export.csv
- current-threatlog: https://internal-logs/pmts/threatlog-2026-03
```

sara: Can we have a brief canary list of open PRs that touch auth/config so we can triage live changes? I'll drop the list in the meeting notes channel before the call.

maya: Yes — please include PR numbers and expected merge dates. Also, if anyone has blocking mitigations we should flag them as "audit-evidence" in the PR labels.

eli: One ask: record the session and capture a screenshot of the trust-boundary diagram in the notes. I'll own follow-ups on telemetry.

jen_privacy: I will prepare a 5-min privacy checklist to run through — retention windows, legal basis, and sensitive PII flows.

maya: Perfect. Outcome goals for the meeting: 1) Clear scope + signoffs, 2) Action list with owners and deadlines, 3) Audit evidence ownership assigned.

maya: If anyone else should be added, ping me here. Otherwise, see you Tue 3pm. :thumbsup:
